comment:
* Provides typed (read-only) access to method arguments and a slot to store a return value.
 *
 * Used to implement method handle transforms. See {@link java.lang.invoke.Transformers}.
 *
 * @hide

variables.name: type
variables.comment:
* The type of this stack frame, i.e, the types of its arguments and the type of its
     * return value.

variables.name: references
variables.comment:
* All reference arguments and reference return values that belong to this argument array.
     *
     * If the return type is a reference, it will be the last element of this array.

variables.name: stackFrame
variables.comment:
* Contains all primitive values on the stack. Primitive values always take 4 or 8 bytes of * space and all {@code short}, {@code char} and {@code boolean} arguments are promoted to ints. * * Reference values do not appear on the stack frame but they appear (in order) * in the {@code references} array. No additional slots or space for reference arguments or * return values are reserved in the stackFrame. * * By convention, if the return value is a primitive, it will occupy the last 4 or 8 bytes * of the stack frame, depending on the type. * * The size of this array is known at the time of creation of this {@code EmulatedStackFrame} * and is determined by the {@code MethodType} of the frame. * * Example : * 
     *     Function : String foo(String a, String b, int c, long d) { }
     *
     *     EmulatedStackFrame :
     *     references = { a, b, [return_value] }
     *     stackFrame = { c0, c1, c2, c3, d0, d1, d2, d3, d4, d5, d6, d7 }
     *
     *     Function : int foo(String a)
     *
     *     EmulatedStackFrame :
     *     references = { a }
     *     stackFrame = { rv0, rv1, rv2, rv3 }  // rv is the return value.
     *
     *
*

methods.name: public final MethodType getMethodType()
methods.comment: * Returns the {@code MethodType} that the frame was created for.

methods.name: public static EmulatedStackFrame create(MethodType frameType)
methods.comment: * Creates an emulated stack frame for a given {@code MethodType}.

methods.name: int getReferenceIndex(int parameterIndex)
methods.comment: * Convert parameter index to index within references array.

methods.name: public void setReference(int idx, Object reference)
methods.comment: * Sets the {@code idx} to {@code reference}. Type checks are performed.

methods.name: public T getReference(int idx, Class<T> referenceType)
methods.comment: * Gets the reference at {@code idx}, checking that it's of type {@code referenceType}.

methods.name: public void copyRangeTo(EmulatedStackFrame other, Range fromRange, int referencesStart, int primitivesStart)
public void copyReturnValueTo(EmulatedStackFrame other)
methods.comment: * Copies the return value from this stack frame to {@code other}.

methods.name: private static boolean is64BitPrimitive(Class<?> type)
methods.comment:
* Returns true iff. the input {@code type} needs 64 bits (8 bytes) of storage on an
     * {@code EmulatedStackFrame}.

methods.name: public static int getSize(Class<?> type)
methods.comment:
* Returns the size (in bytes) occupied by a given primitive type on an
     * {@code EmulatedStackFrame}.
